_meta.description: Human-verified subject->topic aliases for the relations review loop (session 11, ADR 0006). Each `mappings` entry is a 2026-06-13 subject phrasing (from db/human-relations.json) confirmed AGAINST THE INFOCOUNCIL SOURCE DOCUMENT to be the same real-world matter as a current live topic. Written into topic_subjects as source='human' by db/apply-subject-aliases.js so the link survives the next reingest's slug churn (the trend-to-zero mechanism). `leave` records subjects deliberately left unresolved: a generic phrasing with no single valid topic, or a real-world matter the reingest split into 2+ near-duplicate topics — forcing a match would publish a falsehood.
_meta.source_note: Topic ids are the current (session-9 reingest) slugs. If a future reingest re-slugs a mapped topic, its alias dangles and is pruned; re-run apply-relations, then re-confirm the newly-unresolved subject here. The notes carry the source ref so re-verification is fast.
